name: Fidelity to a bf16 reference v1
description: All 24 cases, scored for how far a lane's picture is from a bf16 reference produced on the same box at identical prompt, size, steps and seed: PSNR, SSIM, LPIPS when it is installed, and mean absolute alpha error on the transparent cases.

eval.notes: Requires a reference bundle written by `atlas-bench t2i-reference` from a bf16 run of this same suite on the same machine. The scorer compares meta.render_digest first and refuses to score a case whose reference was produced from a different spec, because a number that looks like drift but is a different picture is worse than no number. An item is correct when it clears both psnr_min and ssim_min.

notes: No reference pixels exist in this repository and none should: a generated image is model output, not authored data (SPEC §0.6). The result publishes the metrics plus a 64-bit perceptual hash of each candidate and its reference, and names the reference run in workload.resolved_params.reference_run_id. Running this suite on the very configuration that produced the reference is a determinism check rather than a quality one: below a perfect score there, the lane is not reproducible at a fixed seed, which is worth recording. The render shape comes from each row's meta.render, not from params: these are frozen cases, and a case rendered at another size or seed is a different picture. params carries only what is the same for all of them.
